_comment: Placeholder fixture manifest for a mobilenet-v1 224x224 int8 model converted with the operator-supplied eIQ neutron-converter. microcode_offset and tensor_count are the guest-posted RUN lookup keys; input_offset/size and output_offset/size are the driver-observable carveout spans. The offset/key values here are placeholders - real numbers must be captured from a Tier-2 boot (see docs/neutron-runner-fixtures.md 'Adding a new model' and the integration plan). tflite_path is operator-local; edit it to point at YOUR converted model (this repo ships no model or NXP content).
